title: An algebraic17-atom operation on a supplied catalogue is not all-allocation optimization
statement: The preserved compressor forms nine independent covariance coordinates plus eight signal coordinates evaluated at the retained canonical multiplier. Exact null-vector elimination changes nonnegative weights, removes atoms and preserves the actual covariance, all twelve cubic targets and canonical cost. Its stated algebraic bound is at most17 atoms, possibly fewer in a restricted covariance subspace. Ordinary/acoustic labels are retained. It does not optimize ray positions or establish efficient arithmetic/bit costs. The captured failed serialization and interrupted exact solve do not constitute a successful final compression run.
